subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should session workspace listings hide/filter transcript-mentioned paths outside fs-safe workspace containment, or intentionally expose existence metadata for them?
rationale: The remaining fix path can change what the Gateway reveals about paths outside the workspace, and automation should not choose that security boundary.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected transcript paths stay hidden, neutral, or filtered, and any false-Missing fix preserves workspace containment.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The Gateway may return existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned external paths, but only with explicit tests and documented boundary acceptance.

options.title: Split UI From Backend Semantics
options.body: Close only the layout subset via merged UI fixes and replace the backend part with a narrower issue or PR after the boundary decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected transcript paths stay hidden, neutral, or filtered, and any false-Missing fix preserves workspace containment.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing and fs-safe preview work makes this the strongest available owner for the boundary decision.
